text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During our outing, as Sounds of Earth was 
playing his violin as usual...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oops, seems I sang with a bit too much 
passion and snapped a string.
choice_data_list: The strings... is the instrument alright?
The strings... is the instrument alright?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Certo! It's just like a snapped shoelace. 
Once you re-string it, it'll sing again.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Are you frightened, Agnellino? I'm sorry 
for startling you. Such a destructive 
sound must have been scary.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
How kind of you! I know, since we're here, 
I'll teach you about instruments. Follow 
me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we arrived at a small string 
instrument shop with an attached workshop.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Sorry to have kept you waiting, Direttore!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to have kept you waiting, 
Direttrice!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I was procuring spare strings. I feel 
terribly uneasy running out of them, you 
see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth, looking relieved, was 
holding nothing at all. When asked what 
was going on—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I left that with the shopkeeper. No 
need to worry, it's just routine 
maintenance."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I get checkups at this shop regularly. I 
usually make an appointment, but they just 
happened to have an opening, so I dropped 
by.
choice_data_list:
So musical instruments need maintenance 
too, huh?

Musical instruments need maintenance too, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì. She is a delicate princess, after all. 
It would be quite rude to neglect 
re-hairing the bow or adjusting the bridge 
and ruin her beautiful singing voice, 
wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I thought you might take an 
interest. Wait right there for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth picked up a book from the 
shelf in the waiting room and began 
flipping through its pages.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
This is a specialized book for craftsmen. 
It goes into great detail about violins.
choice_data_list: What kind of things are written there?
What kind of things are written there?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That's right— For example, this page 
explains how the bridge affects sound 
quality...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The bridge is the wooden piece that 
supports the strings. Its shape changes 
how sound transfers to the body. However, 
the tension from the strings causes the 
bridge to warp, so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sitting beside me, she explained things 
while showing me the book. Though there 
were many unfamiliar terms, I listened 
desperately, wanting to understand..."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Even when perplexed, you are 
adorable! Though, was that perhaps a bit 
too technical?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Is that true...!? O sole mio! Then let me 
tell you more!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as for the bow, that one is... Maybe 
this soundpost is a bit gentler?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Books pulled from the shelves one after 
another were piled high in a towering 
stack right before my eyes...
choice_data_list: Don't tell me you read all of this?!
Don't tell me you read all of this?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì. The violin is my voice, my other half. 
I would do anything in my power to 
preserve its beautiful singing voice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She says it with such a calm face, but 
reading this many books is no small feat. 
It shows just how deeply she treasures 
music.
choice_data_list:
It's amazing that you take care of things 
to that extent!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? I'm surprised that caught you 
off guard. You're quite the attentive one 
yourself, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That can't be true. I'm always full of 
admiration for how attentive and caring 
she is toward everyone around her."

text_block_list.name: String Instrument Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Earth-san, the maintenance is all done. I 
adjusted the position of the bridge 
slightly, so could you check if it's 
alright?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie!! They took such good care of you, 
my princess! Very well, let us play a 
song!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment she took the instrument, she 
began to play. A passionate melody 
resonated throughout the shop...
choice_data_list:
(This sound is the fruit of all her hard 
work)

(This sound is the fruit of all her hard 
work)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Understanding the instrument and never 
neglecting its care. That tone must be 
born from her insatiable greed for the 
ultimate session.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When the performance ended a short while 
later, everyone in the shop broke into 
enraptured applause.
choice_data_list: It looked like your fingers were dancing!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie! This is all thanks to the 
shopkeeper's fantastico work!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I cannot contain my joy! Let us have a 
session for one song, Direttore!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I cannot contain my joy! Let us have a 
session for one song, Direttrice!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clatter, clatter...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was swept up in the excitement 
and about to nod, the sound of the 
doorbell announced a visitor.
choice_data_list: Let's save the session for another time

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, I was simply blinded by joy. 
Shall we head back for today?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Molto bene! What a fascinating way to put 
it!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A new melody was born from your words. 
Now, listen! To this music of pure joy...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clatter, clatter...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was swept up in the excitement 
and about to nod, the sound of the 
doorbell announced a visitor.
choice_data_list: Will you play it for me again next time?
Will you play it for me again next time?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, I was simply blinded by joy. 
Shall we head back for today?
